LanguageData.MCW_GameStartDialog: Chatting about mint chocolate every day is nice, but there is a lot more missing from life than that...
LanguageData.MCW_LetterMinchoSlimePasses:
A group of wandering Mincho slimes is passing by.

Mincho slimes are a product of the Shining World dessert company. Not very bright, but properly farmed they produce a lot of mint ice cream. On death they split into smaller individuals, which makes them hard to wipe out completely.

They will leave in a few days.
LanguageData.MCW_ScenPart_StartWithSmartMincho: One of the Mincho has a smart core
